consequence.statement: An environment that still sets the Consul provider tls.caOptional option will have that setting no longer honoured after upgrading to Traefik v3, because the option has been removed; the migration guide instructs operators to remove tls.caOptional from the Consul provider static configuration.
consequence.remediation: Remove tls.caOptional from the Consul provider static configuration: delete caOptional under providers.consul.tls in the configuration file, the --providers.consul.tls.caOptional CLI flag, or the TRAEFIK_PROVIDERS_CONSUL_TLS_CAOPTIONAL environment variable.

assertion.statement: Traefik v3 removes the Consul provider `tls.caOptional` static configuration option (YAML `providers.consul.tls.caOptional`, TOML `[providers.consul.tls] caOptional`, CLI `--providers.consul.tls.caOptional=true`), because TLS client authentication is a server-side option, and the migration guide instructs operators to remove `tls.caOptional` from the Consul provider static configuration.
